type.quote: The State Board of Dental Examiners shall each year elect from their number a president, vice president and secretary-treasurer

age_minimum.quote: Be of good moral character, be possessed of a high school education, and have attained the age of twenty-one (21) years

degree_required.value: Diploma or certificate of graduation from ADA accredited dental school
degree_required.quote: Exhibit with the application a diploma or certificate of graduation from the ADA accredited dental school

accrediting_body.quote: Commission on Dental Accreditation of the American Dental Association (ADA), or its successor commission

exams.name: State Board Clinical Examination
exams.quote: Each applicant shall appear before the board and be examined to determine his or her learning and skill in dentistry or dental hygiene

exams.name: Jurisprudence Examination
exams.quote: Successfully passes a written jurisprudence examination

interval_years.quote: apply for renewal for such period as set by the board

available.quote: the board, in its sole discretion, may grant a license to a candidate who meets the following criteria

requirements.value: Currently hold a valid, unrestricted and unexpired license in a state whose standards for licensure are determined by the board as equivalent to Mississippi's standards, and which state grants reciprocity or licensure by credentials to licensees of the State of Mississippi; active practice for past five years; no pending disciplinary action; passed state or regional clinical licensure examination within past five years
requirements.quote: Currently hold a valid, unrestricted and unexpired license in a state whose standards for licensure are determined by the board as equivalent to Mississippi's standards, and which state grants reciprocity or licensure by credentials to licensees of the State of Mississippi

exists.quote: The State Board of Dental Examiners shall each year elect from their number a president, vice president and secretary-treasurer

regulatory_model.quote: Every person who desires to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in this state must obtain a license to do so

credential_type.quote: Every person who desires to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in this state must obtain a license to do so as hereinafter provided

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice, attempt to practice or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

title_protection.quote: No person shall practice, attempt to practice or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice, attempt to practice or offer to practice dentistry or dental hygiene within the state without first having been authorized and issued a license by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation in obtaining a license or attempting to obtain, obtain, renew or renewing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation in obtaining a license, or attempting to obtain, obtaining, attempting to renew or renewing a license or professional credential by making any material misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful violation of board rules or regulations or rules of another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful violation of any of the rules or regulations duly promulgated by the board, or of any of the rules or regulations duly promulgated by the appropriate dental licensure agency of another state or jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impaired ability to practice due to illness, alcohol, drugs, or mental/physical condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being impaired in the ability to practice dentistry or dental hygiene with reasonable skill and safety to patients by reason of illness or use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics, chemicals, or any other type of material or as a result of any mental or physical condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing or prescribing medication outside legitimate professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any prescriptive medication or drug outside the course of legitimate professional dental practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or plea for violation of federal or state law regulating controlled substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a violation of any federal or state law regulating the possession, distribution or use of any narcotic drug or any drug considered a controlled substance under state or federal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing incompetently or negligently, regardless of whether there is actual harm
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing incompetently or negligently, regardless of whether there is actual harm to the patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or plea for crime relating to practice of dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a crime in any jurisdiction that relates to the practice of dentistry or dental hygiene

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or plea for any felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being convicted or found guilty of or entering a plea of nolo contendere to, regardless of adjudication, a felony in any jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to unqualified person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, experience or licensure to perform them

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusal to issue or renew license or revocation/suspension in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The refusal of a licensing authority of another state or jurisdiction to issue or renew a license, permit or certificate to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in that jurisdiction or the revocation, suspension or other restriction imposed on a license, permit or certificate issued by the licensing authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Surrender of license in another state to avoid or anticipate disciplinary action
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Surrender of a license or authorization to practice dentistry or dental hygiene in another state or jurisdiction when the board has reasonable cause to believe that the surrender is made to avoid or in anticipation of a disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unprofessional conduct including crime of moral turpitude, fraud, false name, false advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any unprofessional conduct to be determined by the board on a case-by-case basis, which shall include, but not be restricted to, the following: Committing any crime involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Sexual misconduct with patient or staff
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any act which would constitute sexual misconduct upon a patient or upon ancillary staff

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to provide and maintain reasonable sanitary facilities and conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to provide and maintain reasonable sanitary facilities and conditions or failure to follow board rules regarding infection control

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of lawful board order or failure to cooperate with board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of a lawful order of the board previously entered in a disciplinary or licensure hearing; failure to cooperate with any lawful request or investigation by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry while license is suspended
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry or dental hygiene while the person's license is suspended

definition_quote.value: Dentistry is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and/or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and/or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body; provided by a dentist, within the scope of his or her education, training and experience, in accordance with the ethics of the profession and applicable law
definition_quote.quote: Dentistry is defined as the evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures) of diseases, disorders and/or conditions of the oral cavity, maxillofacial area and/or the adjacent and associated structures and their impact on the human body

methods_authorized.quote: evaluation, diagnosis, prevention and/or treatment (nonsurgical, surgical or related procedures)

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe drugs within the scope of legitimate professional dental practice; licensed pharmacists may fill prescriptions of licensed dentists
drug_authority.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any prescriptive medication or drug outside the course of legitimate professional dental practice

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: Application for general anesthesia permit. . . . .400.00 Application for I.V. sedation permit. . . . .400.00

specialist_license_available.quote: Any dentist of this state licensed by the Mississippi State Board of Dental Examiners, who has complied with the requirements specified by the Council on Dental Education of the American Dental Association, or its successor council or commission, in a specialty branch of dentistry or who has otherwise met the requirements of the rules and regulations promulgated by the board may apply for a certificate as a specialist

specialty_practice_scope_restriction.quote: Any applicant applying for a specialty license by credentials must stay within his or her board recognized specialty and must practice only that specialty within the State of Mississippi

specialty_advertising_disclaimer_require.quote: No licensed dentist shall hold himself or herself out to the public as a specialist, or publicly announce as being specially qualified in any particular branch of dentistry, or publicly announce as giving special attention to any branch of dentistry, until he or she has been issued a certificate by the board authorizing him or her to do so

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote: The work of dental hygienists and dental assistants while working in the office of a regularly licensed and registered dentist shall at all times be under the direct supervision of the dentist. Dental hygienists in the employ of the State Board of Health or public school boards shall be limited to only performing oral hygiene instruction and screening when under the general supervision and direction of regularly licensed and registered dentists

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: It shall be unlawful for any person or persons to practice or offer to practice dentistry under, or use the name of any company, association or corporation or business name or any name except his or their own in a manner which is in violation of Section 73-9-61

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: A written work authorization shall accompany all dental laboratory work sent by a licensed dentist to a commercial dental laboratory or private dental laboratory technician

patient_record_retention_years.quote: The original of said written authorization shall be kept on file by a commercial dental laboratory or a private dental laboratory technician for a period of time required by the State Board of Dental Examiners, not to exceed two (2) years from the date it was received
